output.summary: The function fn_01 computes a checksum using a specific algorithm and returns the result.

claims.text: The function initializes the hash value to 0xffffffff.
The outer loop iterates over each byte in the input buffer.
The inner loop processes each bit of the current byte.
The function does not modify the input buffer.
The function writes the result to the output buffer.
The function returns VERA_ERR when the output buffer capacity is smaller than the input length.
The function returns the computed checksum when the output buffer capacity is sufficient.
